payload.claim: The comment says these seven classes have 'no CLOSED_SETS member', but all seven of their CONTEXT.md headwords ('Terminal state', 'Risk tier', 'Batch stop reason', 'Preflight outcome', 'Event kind', 'Fact kind', 'Severity') are literally keys/values of the CLOSED_SETS dict defined at lines 27-39 of this same file, and are already exercised by test_the_two_documents_close_the_set_the_same_way. The comment misdescribes the relationship between the pre-existing closed-set check and the new label check, which no gate catches since it only affects a reader's understanding, not behaviour.
